final_message:
The frozen tools available to me (repo_read, repo_edit, repo_build, repo_find, repo_status, tests_run, tests_list, tests_focus, git_status, git_diff, git_commit, episodes_recall) do not include any capability to query a remote Go module proxy or any external network service. All of these tools operate strictly on the local repository, its test suite, and local episode history — none of them perform network requests or fetch data from external sources like proxy.golang.org.

So: **No**, the frozen tools cannot query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.
